address: 34 Au Trieu Street, Hang Trong Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, 11006, Vietnam
bio: The epitome of simplicity, this shop specialising in phở bò only displays its name on its staff uniforms. The bowls feature raw minced beef, tender flank and tendon gently cooked in rich bone broth with rice noodles and spring onions. Harmonious flavours and pure culinary craft....
